The 2022 cobalt-free review estimates that there are approximately 2 million metric tons of usable cobalt available for battery industries.

The NFA paper estimates that a fleet of one million EVs with NMC 111 cathodes would require approximately 2500 tons of cobalt.

To calculate how many fleets of one million EVs with NMC 111 cathodes this amount of cobalt could supply, we can divide the total amount of usable cobalt (2 million metric tons) by the amount of cobalt required for one fleet (2500 tons):

2,000,000 metric tons / 2500 tons per fleet = 800 fleets

Therefore, the 2 million metric tons of usable cobalt could supply approximately 800 fleets of one million EVs with NMC 111 cathodes.
